text: The world tilts before me, glass and walls at odd angles—echoes and lights distorting my expectations. In this space, thought can drift; I feel the persistent hum of possibility in the R+D lab. Here, research and art meet, making me curious and reflective. Yet the emptiness of the meeting room nearby reminds me of the solitude that often accompanies creative work. I feel like an explorer hesitating on the threshold of discovery, simultaneously drawn in and held at bay by the silence and promise these walls contain.
